Database._comment: Auto-create the campaign database on first startup if it doesn't exist (SQL #4060). Dev only.

Secrets._comment: Auto-generate missing crypto secrets (password pepper, AES data key, IP hash salt, JWT signing key) and persist to dev-secrets.json. Dev only — production must inject from Key Vault.

Bootstrap._comment: Dev break-glass admin. On every startup the bootstrapper rotates this account's password to match the value here (and unlocks it). Plaintext here is acceptable ONLY because this file is appsettings.Development.json — never copy these values into appsettings.json. In production the admin is provisioned via Key Vault / env vars and this section stays blank.
Bootstrap._promoteComment: Email / username strings here get IsSystemAdmin=true on every boot. Idempotent — unmatched entries are logged and retried next boot once the user has logged in for the first time.
